name: goal-setting-protocol-designer
description: Design a structured goal-setting protocol using SMART or implementation-intention frameworks for students. Use when launching units, projects, or developing student self-direction habits.
evidence_sources: Locke & Latham (1990) — A Theory of Goal Setting and Task Performance
Locke & Latham (2002) — Building a practically useful theory of goal setting and task motivation
Zimmerman & Bandura (1994) — Impact of self-regulatory influences on writing course attainment
Schunk (1990) — Goal setting and self-efficacy during self-regulated learning
Morisano et al. (2010) — Setting, elaborating, and reflecting on personal goals improves academic performance

required.description: The unit, project, or task students are setting goals for
Age/year group and goal-setting experience level
Duration over which goals will be pursued

optional.description: Process goals, outcome goals, or both
From context engine: self-efficacy levels, previous goal-setting data
From context engine: rubric or assessment criteria for the task

fields.description: Step-by-step goal-setting protocol with teacher script and student templates
Modelled examples of weak vs. strong goals for this context
Scheduled check-in points for goal progress review
